scope: Lead-authored primary and index summaries after reading actual EP14/15 summaries and source corrections. Native decks are separately reviewed in main plan. No article body change.

index.before: 女子组资格标准六十年间反复更换；2025 年世界田联改采 SRY 检测，进一步显出分类不是发现自然边界，而是选择制度边界。
index.after: 近六十年的女子参赛资格采用过多种判据。2025年SRY检测的引入再次提出一个问题：从生物标志到参赛资格，仍需要经验依据与规范理由。
index.reason: Keep navigation summaries faithful to full revised essay.

index.before: Female-category eligibility criteria have repeatedly changed; World Athletics' 2025 turn to SRY testing makes clear that classification selects an institutional boundary rather than discovering a natural line.
index.after: Women's eligibility has used different criteria across roughly sixty years. The introduction of SRY screening in 2025 raises the question again: connecting a biological marker to eligibility still requires empirical and normative justification.
index.reason: Keep navigation summaries faithful to full revised essay.

index.before: 肯尼亚长跑与牙买加短跑的集中是真实的；把集中压成民族身体的天赋故事，却会把选择、制度与未测量的人一起抹掉。
index.after: 肯尼亚长跑与牙买加短跑的成绩集中是真实的；把它们压成一个天赋的封闭故事，却会略去选择、制度，以及被这个故事留在视野外的人。
index.reason: Keep navigation summaries faithful to full revised essay.

index.before: Kenyan distance running and Jamaican sprinting are real concentrations. Turning them into stories of national bodies erases selection, institutions, and all the people never measured.
index.after: Concentrated Kenyan distance-running and Jamaican sprinting success is real. A closed story of innate talent can nevertheless leave selection, institutions and people outside its account.
index.reason: Keep navigation summaries faithful to full revised essay.
